title: Psionic asset recruited through the GATE program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Psionic asset recruited through the GATE program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: interviewed yesterday a psionic asset who was recruited through the gate program

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the day before, he interviewed a "psionic asset," a person said to use mental or psychic powers for secret work. According to Michels, this person was recruited through the GATE program, which he presents as a program for gifted children. If true, it would mean schools have been used to find young people with psychic talent.
